mapper.select: SELECT ep.id, ep.eval_year, ep.eval_quarter, ep.control_id, c.control_code, c.control_name, c.domain, ep.assignee, ep.planned_start_date, ep.planned_end_date, ep.actual_start_date, ep.actual_end_date, ep.sampling_count, ep.sampling_method, ep.status, ep.created_at, ep.updated_at, ep.created_by FROM itgc_eval_plan ep JOIN itgc_control c ON c.id = ep.control_id WHERE ep.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE itgc_eval_plan SET assignee = #{assignee}, planned_start_date = #{plannedStartDate}, planned_end_date = #{plannedEndDate}, actual_start_date = #{actualStartDate}, actual_end_date = #{actualEndDate}, sampling_count = #{samplingCount}, sampling_method = #{samplingMethod}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, eval_plan_id, sample_no, transaction_id, transaction_date, description, evidence_file, test_result, exception_reason, tester, test_date, remarks, created_at, updated_at FROM itgc_eval_sample WHERE eval_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY sample_no

SELECT id, eval_plan_id, sample_no, transaction_id, transaction_date, description, evidence_file, test_result, exception_reason, tester, test_date, remarks, created_at, updated_at FROM itgc_eval_sample WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE itgc_eval_sample SET test_result = #{testResult}, exception_reason = #{exceptionReason}, evidence_file = #{evidenceFile}, tester = #{tester}, test_date = #{testDate}, remarks = #{remarks} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, eval_plan_id, total_samples, pass_count, exception_count, not_applicable_count, conclusion, evaluator_opinion, reviewer_opinion, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, approved_by, approved_at, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by FROM itgc_eval_result WHERE eval_plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.update: UPDATE itgc_eval_result SET total_samples = #{totalSamples}, pass_count = #{passCount}, exception_count = #{exceptionCount}, not_applicable_count = #{notApplicableCount}, conclusion = #{conclusion}, evaluator_opinion = #{evaluatorOpinion}, reviewer_opinion = #{reviewerOpinion}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ep.eval_quarter AS quarter, COUNT(ep.id) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN ep.status = '완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN ep.status = '진행중' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_progress, SUM(CASE WHEN ep.status = '예정' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS planned, SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective, SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '부분효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial, SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '비효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ineffective FROM itgc_eval_plan ep LEFT JOIN itgc_eval_result er ON er.eval_plan_id = ep.id WHERE ep.eval_year = #{evalYear} GROUP BY ep.eval_quarter ORDER BY ep.eval_quarter

SELECT c.domain, COUNT(ep.id) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective, SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '부분효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial, SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '비효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ineffective, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(ep.id), 0) * 100, 1 ) AS effectiveness_rate FROM itgc_eval_plan ep JOIN itgc_control c ON c.id = ep.control_id LEFT JOIN itgc_eval_result er ON er.eval_plan_id = ep.id WHERE ep.eval_year = #{evalYear} GROUP BY c.domain ORDER BY c.domain
